cards.name: COdA-403a Mutation (Jan)
cards.text: The Blue disease mutates into an incurable, untreatable strain. Marked permanently with a sticker on the Blue disease track; cubes of this strain can never be removed and a cure can never be found for it for the rest of the campaign.

cards.name: Destroyed 4-Disease Objective (Jan)
cards.text: The original win condition (cure all 4 diseases) is physically destroyed and removed from the game after Blue becomes incurable — the campaign's objectives permanently change from this point on.

cards.name: Relationship Stickers (Feb)
cards.text: Permanent stickers applied to two Role cards that grant a situational bonus ability when both of those characters' pawns are used together under specific conditions.

cards.name: Military Base Upgrade (Mar)
cards.text: A permanent Military Base marker is placed on a city (e.g. Ho Chi Minh City) as an end-of-game reward. Military Bases function as extra transport terminals for characters holding military dog tags.

cards.name: Black Disease Positive Mutation (Mar)
cards.text: An end-of-game reward sticker applied to the Black disease, making it easier to cure in future games. Positive mutations must be applied in order (level 1 before level 2, etc).

cards.name: Second Epidemic Warning Token (Apr)
cards.text: A reminder token placed on the second Epidemic card slot in the Player Deck, warning the table that a difficulty spike is coming soon.

cards.name: Faded Figures Introduced (Apr)
cards.text: A new non-cube threat type ("the Faded") is introduced to the board: small figures that spread between cities independently of the disease cube system and must be handled with new tools (roadblocks, equipment, dedicated characters).

cards.name: Roadblock Markers (May)
cards.text: Placed on roads/ferry routes radiating from Military Bases. Halts the spread of the Faded along that route; a character must discard a card to pass through a roadblock.

cards.name: Equipment Stickers (Jun)
cards.text: Stickers applied to City cards that grant a special ability similar in power to an Event card, usable once the sticker is unlocked.

cards.name: Grenade Belt Equipment (Jun)
cards.text: An equipment sticker that lets its holder thin out a cluster of Faded figures in one action instead of removing them one at a time.

cards.name: Losers Box / Box 8 Epidemic Discard Rule (Jul)
cards.text: Introduces a rule allowing a drawn Epidemic card to be discarded instead of resolved, at the cost of permanently increasing a city's panic level.

cards.name: Virologist Search Card (Jul)
cards.text: A multi-step search mechanic: requires moving a character into a Faded-occupied city that also has a research station in order to advance the search for the missing Virologist character.

cards.name: Vaccine Factory Upgrade (Dec)
cards.text: A permanent board upgrade allowing cities to be vaccinated against infection rather than only treated after the fact.

cards.name: CDC Atlanta Search Card (Dec)
cards.text: A multi-step objective card chaining several search actions together to locate a hidden bioweapons stockpile at CDC Atlanta.

cards.name: Recon a New Region
cards.text: Standing objective available from January onward: send a character to explore and reveal a previously unmapped region of the board.

cards.name: Triangulate Signals
cards.text: July objective: successfully completing it reveals three Hollow Men broadcast frequencies (9.2, 9.31, 11.88) used by later objectives.

cards.name: Defect the Hollow Men
cards.text: October objective: broadcast misinformation to lure Hollow Men faction pieces away from supply lines and onto Havens instead.

cards.name: Transport Cure Sample (Baikal to Johannesburg)
cards.text: December objective: physically escort a cure sample pawn from Lake Baikal to Johannesburg across the board without losing it.

cards.name: Remove Plague Cubes (Unrationed Legacy Event)
cards.text: An Event card, not subject to the normal one-per-hand rationing rule, that removes plague cubes from the board; reused across multiple games starting in January.

cards.name: Build 3 Shelters & Destroy a Card (Bernie, Aug)
cards.text: A one-time Legacy Event tied to the character Bernie: build three shelters in a single action and permanently destroy a target card from the game.

cards.name: Well Stocked (London/Frankfurt)
cards.text: A sticker upgrade applied to the London and Frankfurt infection cards making their cities more resilient to outbreaks.

cards.name: Lockdown (Atlanta, destroyed)
cards.text: A Legacy upgrade that was ultimately destroyed rather than kept, removing the Atlanta infection card from future decks.

cards.name: Broken Link (Jacksonville)
cards.text: A sticker upgrade applied to the Jacksonville infection card, altering its connections or infection behavior.

cards.name: Opal — Inoculation Favor
cards.text: Character Opal's unlocked ability card: grants an inoculation effect, protecting a city or character from a future infection.

cards.name: Topaz — Discard to Prevent Infection
cards.text: Character Topaz's ability (based in New Zealand): discard a matching City card to prevent a specific infection card's effect from resolving.
